name: Red Clover Case Files
storyline:
Freshly minted occult auditor John Tsukimori is faced with his biggest case yet: the Séance Soirée, an event hosting the biggest names in spiritualism.

But when a real murder disrupts the circus and fanfare, John must push past the smoke and mirrors of professional psychics to prove the killer is among them — and not in the great beyond.
summary:
A 2D visual novel where the player will be tasked with navigating a murder mystery, investigating crime scenes and other locales, interrogating a collection of bizarre but intriguing characters, and evaluate all you learn to name the real killer.

Or killers.
